text.tspan: Table saw thermal supervisor — low-voltage side (5 V / 3.3 V)
Isolation boundaries external to this sheet:
- AC-DC PSU input: reinforced isolation (Mean Well IRM-05-5 or equivalent)
- Thermocouple: AlN substrate at winding, dielectric to line potential
SR-1: relay is NO, energized-to-close. Floating GPIO26 = relay open.
SR-3: passive thermostat is in series ahead of the relay COM (mains side).
Not shown: mains coil circuit (see hardware/harness/mains_and_coil.svg).
